👨‍💻 VS Code Shortcut Keys in Hindi

Coding seekh rahe ho? Yeh VS Code shortcuts har programmer roz use karta hai – HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python sab ke liye kaam aate hain. (Windows keyboard ke liye)

Is page par 33 shortcuts hain. Search box mein likh kar dhoondo aur Copy dabao.

VS Code Keyboard Shortcuts

ShortcutKya hota haiCopy
Ctrl + Shift + PCommand Palette – har command yahan se
Ctrl + PFile ka naam likh kar jaldi kholo (Quick Open)
Ctrl + SFile save karo
Ctrl + Shift + NNayi VS Code window
Ctrl + WKhuli file band karo
Ctrl + TabKhuli files ke beech switch karo
Ctrl + \Editor ko do hisson mein baanto (Split)
Ctrl + BSidebar dikhao/chhupao
Ctrl + Shift + EExplorer kholo
Ctrl + Shift + FSaari files mein search karo
Ctrl + Shift + XExtensions kholo
Ctrl + Shift + GSource Control (Git) kholo
Ctrl + `Terminal kholo/band karo
Ctrl + ,Settings kholo
Ctrl + /Line ko comment / uncomment karo
Shift + Alt + ABlock comment lagao
Alt + ↑Line ko upar le jao
Alt + ↓Line ko neeche le jao
Shift + Alt + ↓Line ki copy neeche banao
Ctrl + Shift + KPoori line delete karo
Ctrl + EnterNeeche nayi line banao
Ctrl + DAgla same shabd bhi select karo
Ctrl + Shift + LSame shabd ke saare match select karo
Alt + ClickKai jagah ek saath cursor lagao (Multi-cursor)
Ctrl + Alt + ↓Neeche wali line par bhi cursor lagao
Shift + Alt + FPoora code format karo (Format Document)
Ctrl + SpaceSuggestions dikhao
F2Variable ka naam har jagah badlo (Rename)
F12Function ki definition par jao
Ctrl + GLine number par jao
Ctrl + FFile mein dhoondo
Ctrl + HFile mein dhoond kar badlo
F5Debugging shuru karo
